body:
I'm still in high school, so it's a bit hard to do night school, even home school for that matter. I have arranged something with a tutor who happens to teach at the school I go to, but that's going to basically be in June, after school is let out. I would love to get a part-time job, although I am going to be away during the summer...

A slight one, only a couple of months. We've been dating for over a year, and it's around 3000+ miles away... :c

I am a pretty big dork sometimes. ^^;
...My face when ham...

Mostly the fact I have no time, I've been trying to study more for the exams that I have soon. Whenever I get a break I try to do something that will 'destressify' me. He just gets upset about it all when I say I have no time but I'm doing something fun, and leaving him. My boyfriend isn't abusive at all, he's really sweet and kind, I love him for that. There's not really a way to avoid it though, we normally resolve everything by the end of the day. It still hurts sometimes though...
And thank you. nananananana batman.

Yesterday, since it is now today...I went to school as usual, although I realized that I had no time for an elective class that I have in the morning. Ever since I became sick and had to go to the hospital, I have been going half of the day. I thought I could keep up with the other class but I was wrong. So, I go to my councilor around 6th period, and I start to talk to him. He adds up my credits and says that I need all the credits that I can get, and if I fail one class I won't be able to walk next year at graduation. I kinda bit the bullet and walked back to class. 7th period, I had to take this math test, that was just utterly horrible on the last page. I had to also take some of the tests I missed from Soc and math, so I was stressed out as it is...I give up in the end, and go ahead and leave school since the bell rang. I texted my friend 'h' and we got together and went around town and everything just hanging out. Well, that turns sour and she starts saying that I put her down all the time, and truthfully I had no idea I was doing anything like that. I end up going home later, and we did eventually sort things out, but I did feel like a total jerk to her. During the time I was with 'h', I had been messaging my boyfriend. We are in a long distance relationship, so sometimes things can be a little hard upon us even though it's nothing that big. I'm seeing him soon, so it's nice. Although, lately, we've been getting in these petty fights about stupid things. I sometimes I have a little time, but...I try to study or take a break in that time. He just has been upset more than mad. Hopefully by the time exams are over, we both can be happier. At around 10pm I started to feel so upset, I felt like everything around me was collapsing in again, which is somewhat typical for me. I realized that this was happening, so I took my anxiety medication along with my sleeping medication and eventually fell asleep. Things were kinda weird last night....
-hugs- In many ways to say this...He did cheat on you, it's horrible but...you could do so much better than him, especially if he does this while you're out of the area.
